purpose: Controlled source patch that adds a production-compatible runtime wrapper around LangGraphParityRuntimeV2 without changing default backend, dashboard, frontend, memory, FAISS, trading, or env.
design_principles: LangGraph opt-in only via AGENT_V2_BACKEND env var
Do not activate LangGraph by default
Keep /v2/chat/agent response schema stable via response_normalizer.py
No dashboard/frontend changes unless strictly necessary

langgraph_parity_runtime.py: Add create_run(self, goal: str, mode: str = 'read_only', user_id: str = 'local') -> Dict[str, Any]
Add execute_run(self, run_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]
Add plan_run(self, run_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any] (no-op or graph-aware)
Add pause_run/resume_run/cancel_run stubs that raise NotImplementedError or return safe no-ops
Translate graph final state into Native-style run dict with final_answer, provider_metadata, capability_metadata, etc.
Set backend_selected='langgraph_parity', backend_fallback_used=False, backend_fallback_reason=None on instance
runtime.py: Preserve existing fallback guard; no relaxation
Optionally improve log message clarity when LangGraph compatibility check fails

exact_tests_to_add: Test that with AGENT_V2_BACKEND=langgraph, get_agent_runtime_v2() returns a runtime with backend='langgraph_parity' when langgraph package is available and wrapper is compatible
Test that create_run/execute_run return a run dict containing run_id, final_answer, status, provider_metadata, capability_metadata
Test that /v2/chat/agent (via TestClient) returns normalized schema with backend_selected='langgraph_parity' when AGENT_V2_BACKEND=langgraph
Test that read_only mode blocks write tools and sets mode_escalation_required when build intent detected
Test that when LangGraph is unavailable or wrapper incompatible, runtime falls back to native_runtime with backend_fallback_used=true and a reason string
Test trace retrieval contract /v2/agent/runs/{run_id}/trace works for LangGraph run
live_smoke_expectations: Backend health and status still PASS with default backend
With AGENT_V2_BACKEND=langgraph and valid setup, /v2/chat/agent returns ok=true and normalized schema
Dashboard chat and trace proxies continue to work
Fallback to native_runtime occurs if LangGraph setup is invalid
rollback_plan: Unset AGENT_V2_BACKEND or set to native_runtime to restore Native default
Revert only tmp_agent/brain_v9/core/agent_kernel_v2/langgraph_parity_runtime.py and remove the new test file
runtime.py fallback guard ensures Native works even if LangGraph code is partially present
acceptance_criteria: LangGraph backend can be selected only when AGENT_V2_BACKEND=langgraph and package is available
Production runtime compatibility check in runtime.py passes (create_run + execute_run callable)
/v2/chat/agent returns stable normalized response schema regardless of backend
Native remains default and fallback is safe
Dashboard proxies work for both backends
CI green on both required workflows
